name: Floating on gradient
description: The product suspended mid-air against a smooth two-colour gradient with a soft shadow below. The bold shot for launches and paid social.
prompt: Studio product photograph: the product in image 1, unchanged in shape, colour and label, floating in mid-air and tilted slightly toward the camera, against a smooth gradient from {{ from_colour }} to {{ to_colour }}. A soft round shadow on the floor below it, crisp rim light along one edge, no visible support or string. Label sharp and readable. No text, no watermark.
negative_prompt: visible stand, string, hands, warped label, text, watermark, harsh reflections
author: kilnry
